the_seam.description: A dome defender would attack the review as internally incoherent: (a) our Evidence says the dome's 4.87e-12 is 37% away from the textbook value and in the wrong units — i.e. a NOVEL, non-standard number, while (b) our Verdict convicts it under the trivial-transcription/post-hoc test — which requires the dome COPIED a KNOWN textbook value. The defender's move: 'You can't have both. Pick one.'
the_seam.c6_rating: defense_survives=2 (below Mode-3 threshold; the closing sentence is a smaller, narrower seam)

applied_fixes_that_closed_the_seam.what_it_did: Separated the number-critique (units + 37% off, kills on empirical grounds) from the post-hoc-phenomenon critique (precession-as-a-phenomenon is millennia-old textbook physics; asserting precession-is-confirmed adds nothing). The post-hoc critique now attaches to the phenomenon, never to the dome's specific (wrong) number.
textual_evidence_now_present_in_wins_jso: detail_evidence: 'The dome's own published label is "Gyroscopic Precession Rate" — a rate (velocity-class) quantity — so the acceleration reading is a defender retreat the published claim does not make. Even correcting the units charitably from rad/s² to rad/s, the dome's value 4.87×10⁻¹² falls 37% below Earth's measured precession angular velocity of 7.73×10⁻¹² rad/s — the prediction fails on value even after the unit correction is applied.'

detail_verdict_text: 'so labeling precession-exists a confirmed prediction is post-hoc — regardless that the dome's own quoted number (4.87×10⁻¹² rad/s²) does not even reproduce the textbook value, so there is no meaningful sense in which the dome monitor script "predicted" it before reading the data.'

applied_fixes_that_closed_the_seam.what_it_did: Removed the unverified 25,772-year cycle attribution to the dome; 4.87e-12 rad/s does not match the 25,772-year period. The current detail_verdict_text now anchors the standard-physics rate to the IAU 2006 value (50.2881 arcsec/yr, i.e. 25,772-year cycle) as a GLOBE-side fact, not as something the dome claims to reproduce.
